title: Optimistic status-update decoder in client.gleam has no "viewed" arm — stepper flickers to old step until refetch lands
evidence:
let updated_status = case new_status {
                "under_review" -> application.UnderReview
                "shortlisted" -> application.Shortlisted
                "approved" -> application.Approved
                "rejected" -> application.Rejected
                "auto_closed" -> application.AutoClosed
                _ -> app.status
              }
detail: AC: "when the PATCH succeeds, then the status updates ... and the UI reflects the new step." This bespoke decoder (parallel to status_from_string) lacks a "viewed" arm, so a Shortlisted->Viewed click keeps the old status in the local model until the subsequent refetch corrects it — a flicker the other 5 statuses don't have.
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case, or replace the bespoke decoder with `application.status_from_string(new_status)` which already handles all seven values.
